tm.「この階段を上ると ヤヤクさまの社だ。\n ヤヤクさまは この里の長であり\n: "Climb these stairs to Miko's shrine. Miko is this village's chief and the shrine maiden who hears the fire god's oracles.
tm.「うぅ ハラと背中が くっつきそうだ……。\n 火の神さまに 里の作物\n 全部: "Ugh, my belly's sticking to my back... We gave all the village's crops to the fire god.
tm.「あーあ……ひさしぶりに\n かあちゃんの うまい\n ダイコンの ミソ汁が食い: "Ahh... I want my wife's tasty radish miso soup after so long!
tm.「はあぁ………。\n ウチの子が 無事だとわかったら\n ドッと チカラが抜けた: "Phew... Learning my child is safe, all the strength drained out of me...
tm.「ヤヤクさまを 失った今\n この里がどうなるのかは わからんが\n 子供だけは: "I don't know what becomes of this village now that Miko is gone, but I pray the children stay safe whatever happens.
tm.「以前は 鍛冶場で 鉄を打っていると\n ときどき ヤヤクさまが 様子を見にきて: "Back then, when I hammered iron at the forge, Miko would sometimes check in... and call out, asking if I was doing well.
tm.「今でも 鍛冶場で はたらいていると\n フラッと ヤヤクさまが 現れるような…: "Even now, working at the forge, I feel like Miko might suddenly appear...
tm.「こうして かあちゃんと子供が\n 仲良く寝ているところを見ていると\n しみじ: "Watching my wife and child sleeping peacefully like this, I feel truly happy.
tm.「ヤヤクさまと ハリマさまにも\n こういう ひと時が あったのかねえ……。: "I wonder if Miko and Ryu once had moments like this too...
tm.「オレたちは 鍛冶で 剣を作ることはできるが\n 実際に 剣をあつかえる者は\n: "We can forge swords, but hardly anyone can actually wield one...
tm.「剣士のハリマさまは もう いらっしゃらないし\n いざという時 戦える人間がい: "Ryu the swordsman is gone, and having no one who can fight in a pinch is rather unnerving...
tm.「……こうして メシを食べている間も\n 外から 魔物が やってくるんじゃないか: "...Even as I eat, I can't settle, wondering if monsters will come from outside.
tm.「火竜のヤツは ヤヤクさまが倒してくれたけど\n この 妙な胸騒ぎは なんだろう: "Miko defeated the firedrake, so why this strange unease...? Miko would never lie...
tm.「ハリマさまが 戻られたおかげで\n 剣を作る情熱が 戻ってきたぜ……。\n な: "With Ryu back, my passion for forging swords has returned. He's the village's best swordsman, after all.
tm.「外がぶっそうとか 鉄が採りづらいとか\n グチを こぼしてばかりいないで\n: "Instead of grumbling that it's dangerous outside or iron is hard to get, let's do our best for the village too.
tm.「……今頃 ハリマさまと ヤヤクさまは\n 仲良く 晩メシを食べているのかな？\: "...I wonder if Ryu and Miko are having supper together now? I'm a little jealous of Ryu.
tm.「おっと……こんなこと 女房に聞こえたら\n カミナリを 落とされちまうな。\n: "Oops... if my wife heard that, thunder would strike. Munch, munch...
tm.「ヤヤクさまの話によると 火の神さまは\n 今まで きちんと崇めてこなかった\n: "According to Miko, the fire god is angry that we never worshipped properly.
tm.「火の神さまは この地を守る 偉大な神さまよ。\n だから ホムラの里で 生きて: "The fire god is a great god who guards this land. If we want to live in Hotto, we must make offerings and calm the anger...
tm.「いやっ いやーっ！\n ヤヤクさまが いなくなったら\n 私たち 生きていけな: "No, no! If Miko is gone, we can't go on living!!
tm.「火の神さまに 許してもらおうと\n ずっと ずっと 祈り続けてきたのに\n ど: "We've prayed and prayed to be forgiven by the fire god, so why do only sad things happen...?
tm.「あんな おそろしい魔物に 立ち向かえるほど\n 私たちは 強くないわ。\n も: "We aren't strong enough to face such a terrifying monster. Anyone, please, help us...
tm.「これからは 私たちが チカラを合わせて\n この里を 盛り立てていかないとね。: "From now on we must join forces to build up this village. First we need to build our strength.
tm.「さっ がんばるのは 明日からにして\n 今日は ここで のんびりしましょ。\n: "Come now, we'll work hard from tomorrow. Today, let's relax here. Mmm... the breeze feels nice...
tm.「これからは 私たちが チカラを合わせて\n 里を 盛り立てていかないとね。\n: "From now on we must join forces to build up the village. First we need to build our strength.
tm.「さっ がんばるのは 明日からにして\n 今夜は ゆっくり お酒を楽しみましょ。: "Come now, we'll work hard from tomorrow. Tonight, let's enjoy some sake. Mmm... delicious...
tm.「魔物が増えたせいで 鍛冶に必要な\n 砂鉄を採りにいくのが 難しくなったの。\: "With more monsters, fetching the iron sand needed for forging has become hard. The iron we can make shrinks by the day...
tm.「砂鉄は採れないし 商人も行き来できないのなら\n 製鉄所は しばらく閉めたほう: "No iron sand, no merchants. Maybe we should close the ironworks a while. But what else can we do...
tm.「ハリマさまが 戻ってきてから\n なんだか この里の空気が変わったみたい。\n: "Since Ryu came back, the air in this village seems to have changed. Everyone's eyes look lively.
tm.「空には おぞましい色の星が浮いているけど\n ここには 偉大な巫女さまと 剣士: "A star of eerie color floats in the sky, but with a great shrine maiden and swordsman here, there's nothing to fear!
tm.「ここにいると ときどき 火山の方から\n おそろしい声が 聞こえてくるんだ……: "Sometimes from here I hear a dreadful voice from the volcano... Must be a hungry monster.
tm.「なんだか 人食い火竜の 鳴き声と似てるから\n ビクッとして 心臓に悪いぜ。\: "It sounds like the man-eating firedrake's cry, and it startles me. Bad for the heart. Damn it all...!
tm.「なんで 人食い火竜が 生きてるんだよ！？\n クソッ……クソッ！\n まったく: "Why is the man-eating firedrake alive!? Damn... damn! I don't understand any of this!
tm.「最近 火山の方から聞こえていた\n おそろしい声の 正体は\n 人食い火竜だっ: "So the dreadful voice I heard lately from the volcano was the man-eating firedrake...!?
tm.「なぜ ヤヤクさまが 火竜をかばったのか\n 今となっては 誰にも わからねえし: "Why Miko shielded the firedrake, nobody knows now, and we needn't understand a maiden who betrayed the village.
tm.「……ああ クソッ。\n そうと わかっていても やりきれねえよ。\n どうして: "...Ah, damn. Even knowing that, I can't shake the feeling. How did it come to this...?
tm.「里が 平和になったのはいいけど\n やかましい観光客が 来たもんだな……。\n: "The village is peaceful now, but noisy tourists have come... I can't concentrate on work.
tm.「……まあ しんみりしているよりは マシか。\n 今は 過去を忘れさせてくれるだ: "...Well, better than being gloomy. I should be grateful they help us forget the past.
tm.「こうして 夜の静けさに 耳をすませていると\n 火竜に襲われていた 地獄のよう: "Listening to the quiet of night, those hellish days of the firedrake attacks seem like a lie.
tm.「ヤヤクさまのことも ハリマさまのことも\n みんな 夢だったと思いたいけれど\: "I'd like to think Miko and Ryu were all a dream, but it was all our doing...
tm.「ここ最近 ヤヤクさまが\n ヒノノギ火山へ 足を運んでいるのを見て\n 何があ: "Lately I saw Miko heading to Mount Huji and wondered what was there...
tm.「きっと ハリマさまを生き返らせるために\n 火の神さまへ 祈りを捧げていらした: "She must have been praying to the fire god to revive Ryu. Truly, a mother's love is precious...
tm.「ヤヤクさまの 秘密を暴くなんて……。\n こんな勝手なことが 里の誰かに知られ: "Exposing Miko's secret... If someone in the village learned of such selfishness, we'd not escape unscathed...
tm.「……テバは 一度言ったら 聞かない子です。\n どうか うちの子が あぶない目: "Atsuo never listens once he's decided. Please accompany him to Mount Huji so my boy doesn't come to harm.
tm.「えっ……！？\n ヤヤクさまとハリマさまが 倒したはずの\n 人食い火竜が ま: "What...!? The man-eating firedrake Miko and Ryu defeated is still alive...?
tm.「だとしたら ホムラの里が あぶないわ……！\n 私は ここから動くわけにいかな: "Then Hotto is in danger...! I can't leave this place, so please tell everyone about the firedrake.
tm.「火竜が まだ生きていたなんて\n このままじゃ ホムラの里が あぶないわ！\n: "The firedrake is still alive? At this rate Hotto is in danger! Please tell everyone in the village.
tm.「……さっき 人食い火竜が ホムラの里の方向へ\n 飛んでいくところを 見たんで: "...Just now I saw the man-eating firedrake flying toward Hotto.
tm.「私の命と 引き換えにしても\n 守りたかった ホムラの里……。\n どうか み: "Hotto, which I wanted to protect even at the cost of my life... I pray everyone is safe...
tm.「里のみんなは 無事なのかしら？\n ああ……どうして こんなことになったの……: "Is everyone in the village safe? Oh... how did it come to this...
tm.「{var:1}さん。\n 私は ここで サキを守っていますから\n どうか テ: "{var:1}. I'll stay here protecting Atsuko, so please take care of Atsuo.
